expires_at.description:
Absolute expiry time (Unix epoch seconds). Computed as
`now + expires_in` at the moment the response is built. The
SPA + desktop refresh timers schedule against this directly.

expires_in.description:
Token TTL in seconds (relative). Server-authoritative; clients
SHOULD prefer `expires_at` for scheduling because it's an
absolute timestamp not subject to round-trip / clock-skew error.
